cc:Work.dc:title: pKate Stage 3 prediction example
cc:Work.dc:description: GABA example at pH 7.4 showing the input structure, dominant atom-mapped zwitterionic microstate, site pKa values, marginals, confidence, and provenance.

text.style: font-size: 7.8px; font-family: 'cmr10', 'DejaVu Serif', serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #586579

g.text: Population and confidence are different: confidence also reflects applicability, calibration, and model identifiability. *Tautomer weights rank retained candidates; they are not physical equilibrium probabilities.
